label: Huawei MA5671A GPON SFP ONT
description: mini-GPON ONT built into an SFP module (Lantiq PEB98035 SoC, OpenWrt, MIPS 34Kc at 400 MHz, SC/APC BOSA) that presents itself to the host router as an HSGMII Ethernet interface at 2.5 Gbit/s; GPON line rate 2.488 Gbit/s down / 1.244 Gbit/s up with no LAN ports and no Wi-Fi, managed over its TTL serial console (115200 8N1), SSH/Telnet or the web UI.
